evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Imperative to discard prior knowledge, delivered in flat neutral register without urgency markers — weariness-like disengagement rather than alarm.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Second erasure directive in the same low-key imperative register, reinforcing settled disengagement rather than energized command.
